numerical_contract.input: FP32 raw words; no hidden BF16 conversion
numerical_contract.thresholds: one frozen stratified T/K=T frame per k, shared across all output rows/tiles
numerical_contract.sc: four separate bin conversion/divideT, scale multiply and ordered FP32 bin sum; ordered cross-k add
numerical_contract.w8: input-order FP32 multiply then FP32 add (non-FMA), one tile-scale multiply, ordered cross-k add
numerical_contract.reference: shared pinned exact dyadic FP32 oracle; direct integer and temporal dot checks are separate
numerical_contract.scope: synthetic short projection; no model/PPL/physical IID claim
